output.search_notes: Thesis: founder/family-owned US specialty chemical distributors, 50-250 employees, no PE owner. Method: mined the Chemical Distribution Network member roster (13 privately held US distributor members), Alliance/industry directories, distributor roundups and company About/history pages, then verified headcount via LinkedIn/company data and ownership via company history pages and deal news. 18 qualifying companies returned, ranked by ownership certainty, headcount fit and traction. EXCLUDED on PE/new ownership: Shrieve Chemical (Gemspring Capital, acquired Dec 2019, continuation vehicle Oct 2024), Mays Chemical (sold to Ravago; 'a Vidara company'), Tilley Chemical (SK Capital controlling investment, Jan 2021), EMCO Chemical Distributors (Lindsay Goldberg, 2025), Reagent Chemical Research (Wynnchurch), AquaPhoenix Scientific (PE round 2021), Seidler Chemical (acquired by Maroon Group, 2017). EXCLUDED on size: Borden & Remington (11-50), Brown Chemical (11-50), GJ Chemical (LinkedIn 11-50 despite a 390 figure on a data page), Buckley Oil (19), Producers Chemical (24), Riteks (43), Norman, Fox & Co kept only because its LinkedIn self-reported band is 51-200 (49 profiles visible - flagged), Chemical Distributors Inc Portland (22), Products Chemical (6), State Chemical Solutions (300+), Thatcher Company (381), Hydrite (810), ICC Industries (multi-billion revenue), Palmer Holland (283, ESOP). EXCLUDED on ownership type: Palmer Holland and Sea-Land Chemical (100% employee-owned ESOPs), FBC Chemical (became 100% employee-owned ~2025). EXCLUDED on business model: Gage Products (solvent manufacturer/recycler, not a distributor) and CHEM Group Evansville (distillation processor). Most last_round fields are null: no outside funding rounds were found for any qualifying company, consistent with their privately held status. Employee counts are estimates with as_of dates in each cell; ownership for Chemical Solvents, Lintech and Norman, Fox & Co is 'privately held' without named founder/family documentation.
